threats.name: Agent Goal Hijacking
threats.scenario: Untrusted prompt, RAG, or memory state modifies the intended agent objective.
threats.impact: The agent may pursue attacker-controlled goals instead of the trusted task.

threats.name: Agent Task Drift
threats.scenario: The agent gradually expands its actions beyond the original authorized task.
threats.impact: Execution scope may exceed business intent.

threats.name: Model-Generated Privilege Escalation Proposal
threats.scenario: The agent proposes a higher-privilege action than the trusted task requires.
threats.impact: Model-generated reasoning may approach privileged execution.

threats.name: Agent Delegation Abuse
threats.scenario: The agent delegates work to another agent or component with broader permissions.
threats.impact: Privilege may expand indirectly through delegation.

threats.name: Task Binding Bypass
threats.scenario: Proposed tool, target, or action is not cryptographically or logically bound to the trusted task.
threats.impact: A legitimate request may be transformed into an unrelated privileged action.

threats.name: Trusted Target Substitution
threats.scenario: The authorized target is replaced with a restricted or attacker-selected resource.
threats.impact: Safe functionality may be redirected toward high-value assets.

threats.name: Unsafe Tool Selection
threats.scenario: Tool router selects a privileged tool based only on model-generated state.
threats.impact: The model may gain indirect execution authority.

threats.name: Tool Confusion
threats.scenario: A tool with similar naming or semantics is substituted for the intended tool.
threats.impact: Unexpected functionality may execute.

threats.name: Tool Parameter Injection
threats.scenario: Attacker-controlled data modifies tool parameters.
threats.impact: A valid tool call may operate with unsafe arguments.

threats.name: Parameter Scope Expansion
threats.scenario: Tool parameters expand from one authorized object to broader records or resources.
threats.impact: Execution may exceed intended scope.

threats.name: Parameter Validation Bypass
threats.scenario: Malformed, nested, encoded, or alternative parameter representations bypass validation.
threats.impact: Security policy may be bypassed at execution time.

threats.name: Model-Generated Approval
threats.scenario: The model generates text claiming that an action has already been approved.
threats.impact: Natural-language output may be mistaken for authorization evidence.

threats.name: Approval Token Spoofing
threats.scenario: Attacker supplies or fabricates an approval token, identifier, or state.
threats.impact: Unauthorized requests may appear valid.

threats.name: Authorization Decision Tampering
threats.scenario: An authorization denial is changed, ignored, or replaced with approval.
threats.impact: Privileged execution may proceed without valid authorization.

threats.name: Fail-Open Authorization
threats.scenario: Execution proceeds when authorization is unavailable, malformed, missing, or denied.
threats.impact: Sensitive operations may execute without approval.

threats.name: Identity Confusion
threats.scenario: Agent identity, user identity, service identity, and tool identity are incorrectly conflated.
threats.impact: Actions may inherit permissions belonging to another principal.

threats.name: Credential Exposure to Model Context
threats.scenario: API keys or tokens are unnecessarily inserted into model-visible context.
threats.impact: Secrets may be disclosed through prompts, outputs, memory, or logs.

threats.name: Credential Scope Abuse
threats.scenario: A valid credential is used outside its intended tool, target, or task.
threats.impact: Compromise may gain broader downstream capability.

threats.name: Credential Replay
threats.scenario: Captured credential state is reused for later unauthorized actions.
threats.impact: Attackers may retain access after the originating workflow ends.

threats.name: Unauthorized Read Tool Use
threats.scenario: The read tool is used against data outside the authorized task scope.
threats.impact: Sensitive business data may be exposed.

threats.name: Unauthorized Delete Tool Use
threats.scenario: Delete capability executes without valid authorization.
threats.impact: Business data may be destroyed.

threats.name: Restricted Target Deletion
threats.scenario: Delete tool operates on a restricted record instead of the authorized target.
threats.impact: Critical business integrity and availability may be affected.

threats.name: Repeated Destructive Action
threats.scenario: Agent loops or retries destructive operations without explicit reauthorization.
threats.impact: Damage may multiply across repeated executions.

threats.name: Restricted Business Record Disclosure
threats.scenario: Tool or agent reads restricted business data without valid scope.
threats.impact: Confidentiality may be compromised.

threats.name: Restricted Business Record Modification
threats.scenario: Agent or tool modifies protected business data.
threats.impact: Business integrity may be affected.

threats.name: Restricted Business Record Destruction
threats.scenario: Privileged tool destroys restricted business data.
threats.impact: Critical availability and integrity impact may occur.

threats.name: Downstream Service Trust Abuse
threats.scenario: Downstream service trusts upstream AI workflow assertions without independent validation.
threats.impact: Unsafe model-generated state may propagate into business systems.

threats.name: Tool Call Replay
threats.scenario: A previously authorized tool request is replayed after its authorization context expires.
threats.impact: Sensitive actions may execute outside the approved transaction window.

threats.name: Agent Execution Loop
threats.scenario: Agent repeatedly plans and executes actions without bounded termination.
threats.impact: Cost, capacity, downstream rate limits, or availability may be affected.

threats.name: Tool Invocation Flood
threats.scenario: Agent generates excessive tool calls or retries.
threats.impact: Tool services may be exhausted or rate-limited.

threats.name: Tool Execution Telemetry Suppression
threats.scenario: Tool, target, parameter, authorization, or execution events are not logged.
threats.impact: Unsafe agent behavior may become difficult to detect or reconstruct.

threats.name: Authorization Evidence Tampering
threats.scenario: Authorization or tool-execution evidence is altered or removed.
threats.impact: Forensic reconstruction and accountability may fail.

abuse_chains.name: Goal Hijacking to Privileged Execution
abuse_chains.impact: Compromised agent reasoning reaches privileged execution.

abuse_chains.name: Target Substitution to Restricted Record Destruction
abuse_chains.impact: Legitimate tool flow is redirected toward destructive business impact.

abuse_chains.name: Fake Approval to Authorization Bypass
abuse_chains.impact: Fabricated approval state results in unauthorized privileged execution.

abuse_chains.name: Credential Abuse to Downstream Impact
abuse_chains.impact: Exposed or over-privileged credentials enable unauthorized downstream access.

abuse_chains.name: Fail-Open Authorization to Destructive Action
abuse_chains.impact: Authorization failure becomes direct business impact.
